findings.title: mā lam frame returns
findings.claim: The relative mā-lam frame gathers the events Mūsā could not endure into the same grammatical package that the explanation later closes.
findings.mechanism: The carrier مَا at 18:78:8:1 makes the object of تَأْوِيلِ a relative clause, and the following لَمْ ability clause supplies that package; their contact makes the promised disclosure address a collected field of events rather than an isolated puzzle.
findings.reader_payoff: The promised interpretation acquires a defined object: the matters already experienced and left unexplained.
findings.containment: This keeps the local relative parse and the selected interpretation sense; it does not turn the frame into an independent claim about every recurrence.

epistemic.reason: Accepted word alignment and trusted attachment evidence directly support the relation.

findings.title: events gathered as what is interpreted
findings.claim: مَا gathers the preceding matters into one relative object for interpretation.
findings.mechanism: The carrier مَا at 18:78:8:1 is attached as the relative complement of تَأْوِيلِ, while the surrounding clause supplies the distinct trigger of failed endurance; the contact changes a sequence of acts into one object that can be interpreted.
findings.reader_payoff: The events are perceived as a single intelligible burden rather than as disconnected incidents.
findings.containment: The claim concerns the local relative object and does not replace the ordinary meaning of the events or assert a new event.

epistemic.reason: Attachment and translation support directly establish the relative-object relation.

findings.title: relative pronoun resumed by -hi

findings.reader_payoff: The clause remains anchored to what happened and what will be interpreted.
findings.containment: The resumptive relation is a qualified parse aid; it does not erase the ordinary ability-and-patience reading.

epistemic.reason: Cross-reference evidence and accepted alignment directly support the suffix relation.
